## Highlights

- Bug reports now have a built-in diagnostic workflow with error references and a downloadable support bundle.
- PlaylistMuse Settings now includes a **Diagnostics** section with direct access to the diagnostic report and GitHub bug-report form.

## New and improved

- Added persistent rotating application logs under `data/logs` so recent errors survive container restarts without growing indefinitely.
- Added sanitized diagnostic metadata for the running build, runtime, AI configuration state, integrations and local playlist-library schema.
- Added minimal frontend JavaScript error reporting so browser-side failures can be included in diagnostics.
- Server-side 5xx failures now receive a `PM-...` error reference that is shown to the user and recorded in the logs.
- Added a structured GitHub bug-report form and a dedicated `SUPPORT.md` guide describing what information helps reproduce a problem.

## Privacy

- Diagnostic logs are sanitized while they are written and sanitized again when the report archive is created.
- Known local credentials and common secret formats are redacted; raw `.env`, configuration and OAuth token files are never added to the report.
- Users are still asked to review the diagnostic archive before sharing it publicly.
